shared_elements: figures shown in profile facing one direction
a horizontal row of repeated, similarly sized figures
held or hand-held objects (ring/disc-like and staff-like forms)
justification: Both are low reliefs on stone in which similarly scaled figures are lined up in profile along a horizontal band, and in both cases hands appear to grasp small objects, which is the most specific correspondence. Otherwise they diverge sharply: A is a schematic, flat, shallow-cut assemblage of animal forms stacked in several registers on a free-standing weathered block, while B is a smoothly modelled, anatomically detailed procession of robed human figures on a single continuous wall frieze.
